import { copyFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve } from 'node:path'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import type { Plugin } from 'vite'
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'

/**
 * After a build, dist/404.html is a copy of dist/index.html. Hosts that show 404.html for an address they do not know
 * (GitHub Pages) then open the app, and its own router shows the right page. public/_redirects does the same on
 * Netlify and Cloudflare Pages.
 */
function singlePageFallback(): Plugin {
  let outDir = 'dist'
  return {
    name: 'single-page-fallback',
    apply: 'build',
    configResolved(config) {
      outDir = resolve(config.root, config.build.outDir)
    },
    closeBundle() {
      const index = resolve(outDir, 'index.html')
      if (existsSync(index)) copyFileSync(index, resolve(outDir, '404.html'))
    },
  }
}

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react(), singlePageFallback()],
  // This computer only: the preview and the dev server are not reachable from the network.
  server: { host: '127.0.0.1' },
  preview: { host: '127.0.0.1' },
  test: {
    environment: 'happy-dom',
  },
})
